Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing [(Attack Power * 0.2484) * (1 + Versatility) * 2 * 1.144] Shadow damage to the target and [(Attack Power * 0.17155125) * (1 + Versatility) * 2 * 1.144] Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

1242174.d: Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing (205.335% of Attack Power) Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and (64.584% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

1242608.d: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing (35% of Attack Power) Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.

1247378.m: Talent · -10 Runic Power / 1 Rune · 40 yd range · Instant · 30 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
1247378.d: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for (199.665% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and have them explode for (139.421% of Attack Power) Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

1254252.d: Next 1 Scourge Strikes will summon a Lesser Ghoul. (100ms cooldown)

1254552.d:
The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 3.0 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.

Putrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.

1256566.d: Dread Plague has a 20% chance to rouse the dead, causing a Lesser Ghoul to unearth and leap at the target to Putrefy at 100% effectiveness.

1256813.d:
Putrefying a Lesser Ghoul has a 100% chance to reanimate it as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

When you control 3 Magus of the Dead, sacrifice them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 sec, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies. Magus with higher remaining duration grant increased power.

1265574.d: Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Lesser Ghouls by 10% for 8 sec.

1265959.d: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.

1266818.d: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.

1271974.d:
Dark Transformation grants access to Blightfall.

Blightfall
Consume 100% of your plagues around you and deal 200% of their remaining damage instantly.

Grants 1 charge of Putrefy.

1278150.d: Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing [0.85 * (Attack Power * 0.1656) * (1 + Versatility) * 1] Shadow damage to the target and [0.85 * (Attack Power * 0.1143675) * (1 + Versatility) * 1] Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

378848.d: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.

42650.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
42650.d:
하급 구울을 소환하거나 강화하여 30초 동안 8명으로 구성된 부정한 군대를 만듭니다. 활성화된 동안 하급 구울을 소환할 경우, 소환하는 대신 주위 적에 따라 명령을 수행하게 합니다.

죽음의 명령
하급 구울이 함께 공격하여 대상에게 [0.30 * (전투력의 100%) * (1 + $mas / 100)]의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

전염병의 명령
하급 구울이 내장을 터뜨려 주위 적에게 [15 / 100 * (0.21 * ((전투력의 200%)) * (1 + 유연성) * 1)]의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 5명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

43265.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
43265.d:
대상 지면에 부패를 유발하여 해당 범위 내의 적에게 [(전투력의 8.3%) * 11]의 암흑 피해를 10초에 걸쳐 입힙니다.
[
해당 지역 안에 머무르는 동안에는 심장 강타가 최대 0명의 추가 대상에게 적중합니다.]

45524.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
45524.d: 대상을 얼음의 사슬로 속박하여, 8초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

46584.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
46584.d: [썩은위액 누더기골렘: 누더기골렘] [문양: 외눈깨비: 외눈깨비 / 구울]을 소환하여 자신을 도와 싸우게 합니다. 동시에 하나의 [썩은위액 누더기골렘: 누더기골렘] [문양: 외눈깨비: 외눈깨비 / 구울]만 부릴 수 있습니다.

47528.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
47528.d: 대상의 정신을 냉기로 얼려 주문 시전을 방해하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

47541.d:
부정한 마력을 발사해 적에게는 (전투력의 211.812%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 언데드 아군은 (전투력의 463.75%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

공포의 역병과 악성 역병의 지속시간이 1.0초만큼 증가합니다.

48265.m: 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
48265.d:
10초 동안 이동 속도가 35%만큼 증가하며, 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 100%를 유지합니다. 강제 이동 효과 및 밀쳐내기에 면역이 됩니다.

지속효과: 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 70%를 유지합니다.

48707.d: 5초 동안 자신을 대마법 보호막으로 감싸 최대 [총 생명력 * 30 / 100 * (1 + 유연성) * 1 * 1]의 마법 피해를 흡수하고, 해로운 마법 효과에 걸리지 않게 합니다. 피해를 흡수하면 룬 마력이 생성됩니다.

48743.d: 죽음의 서약을 맺어 최대 생명력의 50%를 회복하지만, 15초 동안 최대 생명력의 30%에 해당하는 치유량을 흡수합니다.

48792.d: 피가 얼어붙어 8초 동안 기절 효과에 면역이 되고, 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

49530.d: 공포의 역병이 35%의 확률로 시전자를 황홀에 빠뜨려, 다음 죽음의 고리 또는 전염병의 룬 마력 소모량을 15만큼 감소시키고 공격력은 35%만큼 증가시킵니다.

49576.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
49576.d:
모든 물질을 감싸고 결합시키는 힘을 이용해 대상을 끌어당깁니다.
[
플레이어 간 전투에서는 재사용 대기시간이 10초만큼 증가합니다.]

49998.m: 특성 · 룬 마력 45 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
49998.d: 일격에 어둠의 힘을 집중시켜 (전투력의 176.1%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 또한, 지난 5초 동안 받은 모든 피해의 (20 / 탐식: 21 / 죽음의 일격 연마: 32)%에 해당하는 만큼 자신의 생명력을 치유합니다. 최소 치유량은 최대 생명력의 7.0%입니다.

51052.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간
51052.d: 6초 동안 거대한 대마법 지대를 생성하여 내부의 파티원이나 공격대원이 받는 마법 피해를 15%만큼 감소시킵니다.

55090.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
55090.d:
부정한 일격으로 공격해 (전투력의 135%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 대상의 역병을 분출시켜 35%의 효율로 추가로 1회 피해를 입히도록 합니다.

악성 역병을 부여하거나 주위 적에게 퍼뜨립니다.

61999.m: 룬 마력 30 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
61999.d: 죽은 대상의 영혼과 육체를 암흑의 기운으로 재결합시켜, 60%의 생명력과 최소 20%의 마나를 지닌 상태로 부활하게 합니다.

77575.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
77575.d:
대상에게 공포의 역병과 악성 역병을 겁니다.

공포의 역병
사악한 역병이 24초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 439.11%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 숙주가 사망하면 폭발을 일으켜 주위 적에게 (전투력의 184.5%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 역병에 감염시킵니다. 한 번에 1명의 숙주에게만 부여됩니다.

악성 역병
전염성 역병이 주위의 모든 적에게 퍼져 24초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 202.854%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

85948.d:
적을 베어 (전투력의 202.5%)의 물리 피해를 입히고, 무기를 역병으로 오염시켜 다음 2$null~3회 동안 사용하는 스컬지의 일격이 하급 구울을 소환하도록 합니다.

하급 구울
이성이 없는 스컬지의 종복이 되살아나 8초 동안 주인의 명령을 따릅니다.

191587.d: 전염성 역병이 주위의 모든 적에게 퍼져 24초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 202.854%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

205727.d: 대마법 보호막의 재사용 대기시간이 20초만큼 감소하고, 지속시간과 흡수량이 40%만큼 증가합니다.

206967.d: 자신의 생명력이 30% 이하일 때 받는 피해는 20%만큼 감소합니다.

207167.d:
전방 부채꼴 범위에 있는 대상의 눈을 멀게 하여 5초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하고 방황하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 취소될 수 있습니다.

눈부신 진눈깨비가 종료되면 6초 동안 적의 이동 속도가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

207317.d:
악성 역병에 감염된 모든 대상에게 (전투력의 96.3301%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 주위 적에게도 추가로 (전투력의 38.5326%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

공포의 역병과 악성 역병의 지속시간이 1.0초만큼 증가합니다.

212552.m: 특성 · 집중 (4 초 주문 시전 시간) · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
212552.d:
어둠땅의 힘을 받아들여 모든 이동 불가 효과를 해제하고 4초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 증가시킵니다. 이동 외의 행동을 취하면 이 효과는 취소됩니다.

효과가 활성화되어 있는 동안에는 평상시 이동 속도의 170% 미만으로 감소하지 않습니다.

276079.d:
죽음의 손아귀의 범위가 10미터만큼 증가합니다.

적을 처치하고 경험치나 명예 점수를 받으면 죽음의 손아귀의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

343294.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
343294.d:
적의 영혼을 파열시켜 (전투력의 450%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고 8초 동안 자신의 질병과 하수인에게 받는 피해를 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

생명력이 최대 생명력의 35% 미만으로 떨어진 적에게만 사용할 수 있습니다.

하급 구울 최대 3중첩을 소모하여 즉시 소환합니다.

356367.d: 죽음의 진군, 죽음과 부패, 죽음의 손아귀가 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

374049.d: 광역 공격으로 받는 피해가 3%만큼 추가로 감소합니다. 제어 불가 효과에 걸리면 6초 동안 이 효과가 추가로 6%만큼 증가합니다.

377440.d:
죽은 자의 학자가 15초 동안 가속을 1.0%만큼 증가시킵니다.

여러 번 사용 시 효과가 중첩됩니다.

377514.d:
스컬지의 일격, 고름 일격, 죽음의 고리가 생명력이 35% 미만인 적에게 30%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

어둠의 변신 사용 시 영혼 수확자의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화되고 아무 대상에게나 사용할 수 있도록 합니다. (300밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

383269.d: 악성 역병에 걸린 모든 적의 발밑에서 죽음이 분출해 (전투력의 111.983%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 주위 적에게는 (전투력의 52.6989%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

390259.d: 어둠의 변신이 [어둠의 중재자: 어둠의 중재자와 / 가고일과] 누더기골렘, 학자, 하급 구울을 강화하여 30초 동안 공격력을 25%만큼 증가시킵니다.

433895.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
433895.d:
흡혈의 일격을 가해 (전투력의 169.884%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 최대 생명력의 1%만큼 생명력을 회복합니다.

추가로 20초 동안 피의 여왕의 정수가 부여됩니다.

433901.d:
죽음의 고리, 전염병 및 죽음의 일격 사용 시 25%의 확률로 다음 이 흡혈의 일격이 됩니다.

흡혈의 일격 사용 시 최대 생명력의 2%만큼 생명력을 회복하고 피의 여왕의 정수를 부여해 20초 동안 가속이 1.0%만큼, 최대 5.0%만큼 증가합니다.

434100.d:
생기흡수가 2%만큼 증가합니다.

리치의 혼이 활성화된 동안 이 효과의 생기흡수 증가량이 100%만큼 증가하고 12미터 내의 아군 4명에게도 영향을 줍니다.

434143.d: 자신의 역병에 영향을 받는 적에게 흡혈의 일격으로 피해를 입히면 역병의 지속시간이 3.0초만큼 증가하고, 75%만큼 증가한 효율로 분출시킵니다.

434152.d:
어둠의 변신이 활성화된 동안 산레인의 선물 효과를 얻습니다.

산레인의 선물은 피의 여왕의 정수 효과를 80%만큼 증가시키며, 지속시간 동안 흡혈의 일격이 을 대체합니다.

444005.d:
룬 소모 시 일정 확률로 10초 동안 4인 기사단의 일원을 소환합니다.

모그레인
자신의 위치에 죽음과 부패를 시전합니다. 이 죽음과 부패는 모그레인을 뒤따라 이동하며, 피해를 입힐 때마다 시전자의 질병의 지속시간을 1.0초만큼 연장시킵니다.

화이트메인
대상에게 불사를 시전하여 24초 동안 3초마다 중첩 하나당 (전투력의 6.86532%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입힙니다. 불사는 피해를 입힐 때마다 중첩이 쌓입니다. 이 효과는 갱신되지 않습니다.

트롤베인
대상에게 얼음 결계를 시전하여 이동 속도를 40%만큼 감소시키고 8초 동안 죽음의 기사에게 받는 피해를 5%만큼 증가시킵니다.

나즈그림
나즈그림이 활성화된 동안 종말의 정복자가 부여되어 힘이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

444010.d:
죽음의 군마를 불러내 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어납니다.

죽음의 군마에 탑승하면 10초 동안 이동 속도가 100%만큼 증가하며, 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 100%를 유지하고 강제 이동 효과 및 밀쳐내기 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

444033.d: 로 불사에 영향을 받는 적에게 피해를 입히면 1중첩이 증가하고 다른 주위의 적을 감염시킵니다.

444040.d: 사자의 군대와 서리고룡의 격노 사용 시 20초 동안 4인 기사단 전원을 부릅니다. (1초 재사용 대기시간)

444047.d: 모그레인의 죽음과 부패 안에 있는 동안 공격력이 5%만큼 증가하고 죽음과 부패의 이로운 효과가 부여됩니다.

444072.d: 지원 중인 기사단원이 2명 이상일 경우, 죽음의 고리가 20%의 추가 피해를, 전염병은 20%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

454842.d: 받는 마법 피해가 5%만큼 감소하고 자신에게 걸리는 해로운 마법 효과의 지속시간이 35%만큼 감소합니다.

455397.d:
고름 일격 사용 시 후속 공격으로 룬을 소모하지 않는 부패의 낫을 가합니다.

부패의 낫
전방 14미터 내의 모든 적을 베어 (전투력의 101.25%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 적중당한 대상에게 걸린 모든 역병을 촉진해 25초 동안 피해를 35%만큼 더 빨리 입히게 합니다.

1233448.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
1233448.d:
구울을 타락시켜 괴수로 진화시키고 15초 동안 능력을 크게 강화합니다.

죽음의 고리와 전염병은 이 효과의 지속시간을 1.0초만큼 증가시킵니다.

1234559.d: 죽음과 부패가 피해를 입히는 속도가 100%만큼 빨라집니다.

1241567.d:
어둠이 공격을 인도하여 스컬지의 일격의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 할퀴는 어둠이 부여되며, 최대 4번까지 중첩됩니다.

할퀴는 어둠 중첩 하나당 스컬지의 일격이 추가 적을 연쇄적으로 가격합니다. 연쇄적으로 가격할 때마다 10%만큼 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1241705.d:
하급 구울 하나당 영구적인 구울의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가하며, 어둠의 변신 사용 시 추가로 하급 구울의 발톱 공격이 발톱 휩쓸기로 강화됩니다.

발톱 휩쓸기
변형된 발톱으로 적을 할퀴어 대상에게 [(전투력 * 0.2484) * (1 + 유연성) * 2 * 1.144]의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 주위의 적에게는 [(전투력 * 0.17155125) * (1 + 유연성) * 2 * 1.144]의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

1242174.d: 휘몰아치는 괴저 마력과 뼈를 방출해 최대 3명의 적에게 (전투력의 205.335%)의 암흑충격 피해를 입히고, 관통당한 모든 적에게 (전투력의 64.584%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

1242608.d: 사자의 군대 사용 시 30초 동안 누더기골렘을 되살립니다. 누더기골렘은 적을 공격하며 질병 구름을 발산해 주위의 적에게 2초마다 (전투력의 35%)의 역병 피해를 입힙니다.

1247378.m: 특성 · 룬 마력 -10 / 룬 1 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1247378.d: 하급 구울을 소환합니다. 하급 구울은 적을 공격해 (전투력의 199.665%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 폭발해 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 139.421%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

1254252.d: 다음 1회의 스컬지의 일격이 하급 구울을 소환합니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1254552.d:
부패의 폭발 효과 발동 시 역병의 지속시간이 3.0초만큼 연장되고, 지속시간에 걸쳐 입힐 피해의 35%를 즉시 입힙니다.

부패 시전 시 역병에 영향을 받지 않는 대상에게 역병을 부여합니다.

1256566.d: 공포의 역병이 20%의 확률로 망자를 깨워, 하급 구울이 땅에서 솟아나 대상에게 도약해 100%의 효율로 부패를 사용합니다.

1256813.d:
하급 구울을 부패시키면 100%의 확률로 15초 동안 죽은 자의 학자로 되살려, 적에게 얼음 화살과 어둠의 화살을 날리게 합니다.

죽은 자의 학자를 3명 지배하게 되면 이들을 희생해 15초 동안 죽은 자의 군주를 소환합니다. 죽은 자의 군주는 2명의 적을 연쇄적으로 가격하는 얼음 화살을 시전합니다. 남은 지속시간이 긴 학자일수록 군주를 더 강하게 만듭니다.

1265574.d: 흡혈의 일격 사용 시 8초 동안 하급 구울의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

1265959.d: 어둠의 변신 시전 시 6초 동안 화이트메인을 소환합니다.

1266818.d: 죽음의 서약의 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼 감소하며, 죽음의 서약의 피해 흡수 효과가 활성화된 동안 받는 치유 효과가 50%만큼 증가합니다.

1271974.d:
어둠의 변신이 역병내림을 사용할 수 있도록 합니다.

역병내림
주위 역병의 100%를 소모하여 남은 피해를 200%만큼 즉시 입힙니다.

부패가 1회 충전됩니다.

1278150.d: 변형된 발톱으로 적을 할퀴어 대상에게 [0.85 * (전투력 * 0.1656) * (1 + 유연성) * 1]의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 주위의 적에게는 [0.85 * (전투력 * 0.1143675) * (1 + 유연성) * 1]의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

378848.d: 정신 얼리기로 적의 주문 시전을 성공적으로 방해하면 10의 룬 마력을 얻고 재사용 대기시간이 3초만큼 감소합니다.

1: [차단] Put Mind Freeze (15 sec) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy). With Coldthirst, each successful kick cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec.

[제어] When a Spellsower runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, pull it back with Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo, +10 yd range with Death's Reach) to stop Frantic Blooming, then apply Chains of Ice (70% slow for 8 sec) so it cannot run again.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust is up, spread plagues with Outbreak, then use Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) together. Absorb Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, stop both at once with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient) and kick the remaining cast with Mind Freeze. Damage can break Blinding Sleet, so use it only to stop casts.
[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Spouting Floret. If the Anti-Magic Shell from pull 1 (40 sec) is not back yet, take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
3: [차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Mind Freeze and Death Grip, and put Chains of Ice on any Spellsower that runs with Call The Grove.
[회피] When Virid Grovekeeper casts Uproot (3 sec cast), press Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo). It makes you immune to knockbacks for 10 sec so you keep your melee position.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so Blinding Sleet does not work on it. Focus Scourge Strike and Putrefy on that Lasher and break the shield first.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Mind Freeze. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.

[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell on the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and press Death's Advance for the Uproot of the Virid Grovekeeper that arrives 5-6 sec later to ignore the knockback.
[참고] Neither Unholy M+ build takes a stun (Asphyxiate). Leave the Thorny Saptor Thornclaw Leap stun to party members who have one.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Mind Freeze, and once the Coldthirst-reduced cooldown is back, kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot too.

[참고] While Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield is up on the 5 beetles, hitting them with Epidemic and Scourge Strike returns 4849 Nature damage. Press Anti-Magic Shell while breaking the shields to absorb the reflected damage.
8: [차단] The two Leafy Grovecrawlers cast Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast) from range, so Death Grip (2 charges) them into the pack and kick the next Seed Shot with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] Timing Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret also absorbs the reflected Nature damage from Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield.
10: [광역 피해] Unholy cannot dispel Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT). When you see the cast, press Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the hit and the Nature damage of the DoT.
[우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher activates its Lightbloom Pollination shield, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed, so focus Scourge Strike and Putrefy on that Lasher and break the shield (600108).
[참고] Potatoad Matriarch has a lot of health and lives long, so if Army of the Dead is ready, use it on this pull together with Dark Transformation.
11: [차단] When all three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech, stop them at once with Blinding Sleet (5 sec frontal-cone disorient) and kick the rest with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Spouting Floret. If the Anti-Magic Shell used on pull 10's Toxic Spew (40 sec) is not back, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
12: [우선 처치] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, stack Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy on this pull to break the shields together. Shielded Lashers are immune to crowd control.
[차단] Kick the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley with Mind Freeze, and if both cast together, stop them at once with Blinding Sleet.
[광역 피해] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] For the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction), kick one with Mind Freeze (15 sec) and Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo) the other to stop its cast. With Coldthirst, a successful Mind Freeze kick cuts its cooldown by 3 sec.

[광역 피해] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots is a magic effect, so pre-casting Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration) keeps the 20 sec Nature DoT and slow from landing on you.
2: [우선 처치] Line up Putrefy (30 sec) and Dark Transformation (45 sec) on the Ritual Chieftain and focus Scourge Strike on it to end the Unstable Totem damage quickly.

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice is Physical damage, so Anti-Magic Shell cannot absorb it. If you are low, take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec) and heal back with Death Strike.
3: [차단] Split the Piercing Hiss casts of the three Primal Serpents that walk down behind the pillar between Mind Freeze and both Death Grip charges, and if all three cast together in front of you, stop them at once with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient).
[우선 처치] Use Putrefy on the Ritual Chieftain and focus Scourge Strike on it. If you used Icebound Fortitude on pull 2, survive this pull's Blood Sacrifice with Death Strike.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull (103 count). Spread plagues with Outbreak, then use Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation and Putrefy together, putting Putrefy and Scourge Strike into the Ritual Chieftain first.
[광역 피해] Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell against the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots to block the Nature DoT, and use Icebound Fortitude if Blood Sacrifice overlaps the DoTs and your health drops.
[차단] Kick the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Mind Freeze, and stop Evolve (6 sec channel) by pulling it with Death Grip. A completed Evolve grants a shield and crowd control immunity.

[광역 피해] Anti-Magic Shell cannot reduce Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec), so take it with Icebound Fortitude. If an Envenom Nature DoT overlaps, absorb that DoT damage with Anti-Magic Shell.
9: [위치] Death Grip (+10 yd range with Death's Reach) the High Evolutionist standing far to the left into the pack, then kick its next Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze.
[우선 처치] Focus Putrefy and Scourge Strike on the two High Evolutionists so they die before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] Kick the Mass Envenom of your assigned High Evolutionist out of the four with Mind Freeze, and stop the other Evolutionists' Evolve by pulling them with both Death Grip charges. Neither Unholy M+ build takes a stun, so leave Evolve stuns to other party members.
[제어] If several Evolutionists cast together in front of you, stop them at once with Blinding Sleet. Damage can break Blinding Sleet, so use it only to stop casts.
12: [광역 피해] Press Anti-Magic Shell for Ascendant Serpent's Infest (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then a 69827 Nature burst within 8 yd) to absorb the DoT and the burst, and place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for 6 sec) when the group stacks on the tank's spot.
[우선 처치] It must die before the third Infest, so line up Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation on the Ascendant Serpent.
13: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom. If kicks run short, stop the cast with Death Grip.

[우선 처치] Hold Epidemic so the Living Venoms do not all burst at once, and focus Scourge Strike and Putrefy on Ula'tek's Chosen. Press Anti-Magic Shell for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec).
14: [광역 피해] Press Anti-Magic Shell for Toxic Surge, and if you used Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec) on pull 13 only recently, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
[우선 처치] Living Venoms must be killed in parts, so do not dump Army of the Dead and Epidemic into them; kill Ula'tek's Chosen first.
15: [차단] Kick the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
[광역 피해] Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell against Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots to block the Nature DoT and slow.
16: [차단] Kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom every time with Mind Freeze, and line up Putrefy and Dark Transformation on the Chosen so it dies before the second Toxic Surge.

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice comes back to back and Toxic Surge overlaps it on this pull. Place Anti-Magic Zone for Toxic Surge and absorb the Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell, and use Icebound Fortitude when the Physical Blood Sacrifice overlaps.
[광역 피해] If Army of the Dead (1.5 min) is back after pull 12, use it on this pull with the two Ritual Chieftains.

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together with Bloodlust. Spread plagues with Outbreak, then use Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) together, putting Putrefy and Scourge Strike into the Bribed Captain first.
[참고] When Row Hooligan's Cutpurse leaps on you and applies its bleed (155172 over 8 sec), heal back with Death Strike. Unholy cannot dispel the Heartstop Poison.
2: [차단] Each Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) needs its own kicker. Kick your assigned Sayaad with Mind Freeze (15 sec), and if kicks run short, stop the cast by pulling it with Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo).
5: [우선 처치] Massive Felwyrm's Over-infused triggers Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd) every 3 sec, so line up Putrefy and Dark Transformation on the Massive Felwyrm and absorb the stacking Fire damage with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
[회피] When Massive Felwyrm dies, a 290947 Fire burst within 10 yd (Massive Fel Detonation) goes off 5 sec later. If you were in melee, leave 10 yd right away with Death's Advance (45 sec).
8: [차단] Stop the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel channels with Mind Freeze and Death Grip, and kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd control immunity) with the Coldthirst-reduced Mind Freeze too.

[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and starts dealing Fire damage to the group with Demonic Frenzy, dump the saved Dark Transformation and Putrefy into the Punisher to kill it fast. Step out of melee to avoid Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd).
9: [광역 피해] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, Unholy cannot drop combat, so press Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec). Unholy cannot dispel the Curse of Doom curse.
[우선 처치] When the Warlock puts up its Dark Pact shield (30% of max health) at 50%, break it with Putrefy and Scourge Strike. Kill the eight Demon Flies together with Epidemic.
[차단] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel with Mind Freeze.
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, stack Dark Transformation and Putrefy on it, and kill the eight Demon Flies together with Epidemic.
11: [광역 피해] Absorb Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for 6 sec) if the group is struggling. Split Anti-Magic Shell and Anti-Magic Zone across different Blade Dances.
[우선 처치] Line up Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation on Felmaster Lucsei so Blade Dance does not go out more than three times.
13: [광역 피해] Place Anti-Magic Zone as a group defensive for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to all enemies), and absorb it yourself with Anti-Magic Shell.
[우선 처치] Line up Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Defiled Golem, and kill the Unleashed Imps together with Epidemic.
[차단] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
14: [차단] Between the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage and Fel Invoker's Health Funnel, stop Fel Rage first with Mind Freeze and Death Grip. A Flayer with Fel Rage takes 60% less damage and is immune to crowd control.
[광역 피해] Kill the six Unleashed Imps together with Epidemic and Putrefy.
15: [위치] Do not fight Corrupted Warlock and Shivan Punisher together: pull the Warlock out with Death Grip (+10 yd range with Death's Reach) and kill it first on its own.
[광역 피해] If Drain Life targets you, press Icebound Fortitude. When the Punisher starts Demonic Frenzy below 50%, stack Dark Transformation and Putrefy to kill it fast.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Army of the Dead (if it is back), Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Defiled Golem so it dies within two Defiled Slams.
[광역 피해] Place Anti-Magic Zone for one of the two Defiled Slams as one of the group defensives, and if you used Anti-Magic Zone (4 min) on pull 13, absorb it only for yourself with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Stop the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust and cooldown pull. Spread plagues with Outbreak, then use Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) together.
[우선 처치] Break Spirit of Hunger's Starvation Effigy totem with Scourge Strike and Putrefy before it casts Insatiable Hunger (6 sec cast, curse reducing max health by 15%) a second time.
[광역 피해] Absorb Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration). Unholy cannot dispel the Insatiable Hunger curse.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) with Mind Freeze (15 sec), and stop the following Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast) by pulling it with Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo). With Coldthirst, a successful Mind Freeze kick cuts its cooldown by 3 sec.
[광역 피해] Press Anti-Magic Shell for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery, and break the Starvation Effigy totem first with Putrefy.
3: [차단] Split Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and Earth Bolt between Mind Freeze and Death Grip, and absorb Feast of Misery with Anti-Magic Shell.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss. If the Army of the Dead (1.5 min) used on pull 1 is back, use it with Dark Transformation and Putrefy.

[차단] If both Earthwhisper Tenders cast Healing Breeze together, kick one with Mind Freeze and stop the other with Death Grip, and if they stand together in front of you, stop both at once with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec frontal-cone disorient).
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield is up, the whole group takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec. Line up Putrefy and Dark Transformation on the Rumbler to break the shield fast, and absorb the damage with Anti-Magic Shell if it stacks up.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. Line up Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy with Bloodlust, putting Putrefy into the Terra Rumbler shield first.
[차단] Kick the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction) one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
10: [차단] The two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar has a long cast and is easy to kick. Take one with Mind Freeze, and stop the other with the Coldthirst-reduced Mind Freeze or Death Grip.
[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust, so use Dark Transformation and Putrefy here.
11: [우선 처치] Line up Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation on Avatar of Determination and kill it first, then put Putrefy into the Terra Rumbler shield.

[회피] Pulverize (4 sec cast) stuns everyone within 12 yd for 4 sec and deals 387930 Physical. If you cannot leave melee, press Icebound Fortitude (2 min, stun immunity and 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
13: [차단] Kick the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.

[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem right away with Putrefy and Scourge Strike. When Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical) builds up, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
14: [우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) right away with Putrefy and Scourge Strike, and absorb the Fire damage with Anti-Magic Shell if it stacks up.
[제어] When Bonded Beasttamer's Bestial Wrath makes a Loyal Saberfang fixate and chase a party member, slow it with Chains of Ice (70% slow for 8 sec).
[광역 피해] If the third Bloodlust goes out on this pull, line up Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation with it.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo comes in turns, so use Icebound Fortitude when the stacks are high and heal through the next Echo with Death Strike.
[차단] Kick the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Mind Freeze and Death Grip, and break Magma Totems right away with Putrefy.
[광역 피해] This is a big pull (85 count), so use Army of the Dead here if it is back.
16: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] The three Volatile Totems must die before the third wave, so put Putrefy and Scourge Strike into the totems. If Bloodlust goes out here on high keys, line up Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation.
[위치] If you are targeted by Earthquake, leave the group quickly with Death's Advance (45 sec, 2 charges with Death's Echo).

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes the first corridor up to the Voidtouched Magi in one go with Bloodlust. Spread plagues with Outbreak, then use Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) together, putting Putrefy into the Voidtouched Magi first.

[차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd), so kick the second cast that follows with Mind Freeze (15 sec). Stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with the Coldthirst-reduced Mind Freeze or Death Grip.
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Null Eruption, leave the group and press Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration) to absorb the 145474 Shadow hit and the 5 sec DoT.
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons the three Orb of Disruption orbs, switch at once and break them with Putrefy and Scourge Strike. If even one cast finishes, the group loses a lot of haste.

[광역 피해] The tooltip gives no school for the long Thundering Storm party damage, so take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec), and absorb Forked Lightning (77586 Nature) with Anti-Magic Shell when it bounces to you.
3: [광역 피해] Place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for 6 sec) for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec) and absorb it yourself with Anti-Magic Shell.

[위치] Pull mobs inside Protective Turtle's Shell Guard (75% damage reduction for nearby allies) and a far-away Angry Krolusk out with Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo, +10 yd range with Death's Reach) and kill them fast.

[우선 처치] When Brutok hits a wall and Concussion stuns it for 5 sec with 20% more Physical damage taken, stack Dark Transformation and Putrefy on Brutok. If Army of the Dead is back, use it on this 158-count pull.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area, so hold Mind Freeze for it, and if it is missed, stop the cast by pulling it with Death Grip.
[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), leave the group and absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.
6: [우선 처치] When Brutal Overseer raises its Brutal Slams shield, stack Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Overseer to break it fast. It must die before the next shield so it does not overlap with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak.
[광역 피해] Brutal Slams is Physical damage that grows 10% per slam, so Anti-Magic Shell cannot reduce it. Take it with Icebound Fortitude when the stacks get high.
8: [우선 처치] Put Putrefy and Scourge Strike right away into the low-health mob (marked with an icon) that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast) and kill it before the cast ends. This is a cooldown pull, so use Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation too.
[광역 피해] Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast) knocks back and applies a 12 sec Shadow DoT. When you see the cast, press Death's Advance to ignore the knockback and absorb the DoT with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Always kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Mind Freeze, and kick Voidminder's Mending Void only when Mind Freeze is spare.
9: [차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Mind Freeze first, and stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Death Grip.
[광역 피해] Absorb Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow DoT with Anti-Magic Shell, and kill the ten Scavenging Siphoids together with Epidemic.
10: [우선 처치] Kill the Devour target right away with Putrefy, and when Watchful Harrower joins, use Army of the Dead (if it is back) and Dark Transformation on the Harrower.
[광역 피해] If the Dreadbellow DoT overlaps Void Beam, place Anti-Magic Zone and absorb your own Shadow damage with Anti-Magic Shell.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon, so Bloodlust goes out. Spread plagues with Outbreak, then use Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) together, putting Putrefy into the Shadow-Borne Champion first to cut down how many Shadow Whirlwinds it gets out.

[광역 피해] Absorb Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration) timed to the end of the cast. If Anti-Magic Shell is not back for the next cast, press Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Mind Freeze (15 sec). Unholy cannot dispel the curse, so if Mind Freeze is on cooldown, pull the Hexer with Death Grip to stop the cast.

[광역 피해] This pack is taken separately as a cooldown pull. Line up Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Shadow-Borne Champion, and add Army of the Dead if it is back. Take Shadow Whirlwind with Anti-Magic Shell and Icebound Fortitude in turn, as on pull 1.
4: [차단] Kick Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec charm) and Soul Bolt, and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending heal with Mind Freeze. A successful kick cuts Mind Freeze's cooldown by 3 sec through Coldthirst. If kicks run short, pull the caster with Death Grip to stop it.

[광역 피해] The four groups wake one at a time, so use Dark Transformation and Putrefy on each group only after the tank has aggro, and save Army of the Dead for the hardest group, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins. If Blood Drain (164870 Physical) hits you while Sudden Rupture is bleeding you in that group, press Icebound Fortitude, and heal back with Death Strike after the bleed.

[회피] When King Timalji's Bladestorm (164870 Physical every 0.5 sec) comes toward you, get out of melee with Death's Advance (45 sec, 35% movement speed for 10 sec). Absorb King Rahu'ai's Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bouncing) with Anti-Magic Shell.
5: [광역 피해] Absorb Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to all enemies) with Anti-Magic Shell, and if the healer cannot keep up, place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for 6 sec) as a group defensive.
[참고] If Bloodlust goes out here on a high key, line up Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation on the Construct. Kill the pulled Embalming Fluids together with Epidemic.
6: [차단] The two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, a disease dealing 116379 Nature every 2 sec for 12 sec) needs two kicks. Kick one with Mind Freeze, and if Mind Freeze is on cooldown, pull the other with Death Grip to stop it.
[광역 피해] If a Wretched Discharge goes through, Unholy cannot dispel the disease, so absorb the Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell.
7: [차단] Split the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge between Mind Freeze and Death Grip, as on pull 6.
[광역 피해] Spread plagues to the eight Embalming Fluids with Outbreak and kill them together with Epidemic.
9: [우선 처치] Put Putrefy and Scourge Strike into the two Spectral Shamans so they die first, and keep Dark Transformation up while you kill them.

[차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast Spectral Bolt and Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) nonstop. Kick Hex with Mind Freeze, and when both cast together, stop both with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec disorient in a frontal cone) or pull one in with Death Grip to stop it.
[참고] When Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (29095 Physical every 1 sec for 12 sec) stack up, press Icebound Fortitude, and heal back with Death Strike after the bleed.
10: [광역 피해] On a four-Bloodlust route, the third Bloodlust goes out on this pull. Line up Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Ghostly Brute.
[회피] Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby and a knock-up) hits melee, so leave during the cast with Death's Advance.
[차단] Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Mind Freeze.
12: [참고] Shadow Barrage (58190 Shadow plus a 4 sec DoT) goes to whoever engages first, so do not engage with Death Grip or Outbreak before the tank is on it.
[광역 피해] If Dark Revelation (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec) targets you, move 20 yd away from the group and absorb the damage with Anti-Magic Shell.

1: [차단] Kick the two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a shield and crowd control immunity every 3 sec) with Mind Freeze (15 sec), and if Mind Freeze is on cooldown for the second Chillweaver, pull it with Death Grip to stop the channel.
[우선 처치] Spread plagues with Outbreak, then line up Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) on the crowd-control-immune Primal Juggernaut.

[광역 피해] For Primal Juggernaut's Excavating Blast (3.5 sec cast, 106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT), turn on Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration) at the end of the cast to absorb the DoT too.
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Mind Freeze.
[우선 처치] Put Dark Transformation and Putrefy into the Primal Juggernaut, and absorb Excavating Blast with Anti-Magic Shell.
3: [광역 피해] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage hits the tank every 0.5 sec, and each strike deals 24246 Fire to the group within 60 yd. Turn on Anti-Magic Shell on the Steel Barrage cast to absorb the fire novas.
[차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Mind Freeze, and line up Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the crowd-control-immune Defier Draghar.
5: [차단] Per Topicx, kicks go to Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) first. Kick one with Mind Freeze and pull the other with Death Grip to stop it.

[광역 피해] Absorb Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (3.5 sec cast, 96982 Fire within 60 yd plus a 5 sec DoT) with Anti-Magic Shell. When the Destroyer casts Burnout as it dies, leave 20 yd from melee with Death's Advance (45 sec, 35% movement speed for 10 sec).
[참고] Neither Unholy Mythic+ build has a stun. Leave Ashseer Flamelasher's uninterruptible Flaming Barrage channel to a party member with a stun, and spend Mind Freeze on Cinderbolt.
6: [우선 처치] Below 50% Flamegullet grows the group Fire damage with Molten Blood, so line up Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy with the 50% window and kill it fast. On +17 and above, Bloodlust goes out here.

[광역 피해] When Molten Blood stacks overlap with the Destroyer's Inferno, absorb them with Anti-Magic Shell, and place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for 6 sec) if the group is struggling.
[차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Mind Freeze.
7: [차단] Split the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt between Mind Freeze and Death Grip, as on pull 5.
[광역 피해] Absorb Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno with Anti-Magic Shell, and leave the 20 yd Burnout explosion with Death's Advance when the Destroyer dies.
8: [차단] Stop the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Mind Freeze and Death Grip. Do not Death Grip a mob that stands toward the patrolling Thunderhead.
[광역 피해] Absorb Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno with Anti-Magic Shell, and leave Burnout with Death's Advance.
10: [광역 피해] If Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every 1 sec) targets you, turn on Anti-Magic Shell right away. Its 7 sec duration absorbs the whole channel.
[광역 피해] Spread plagues to the six Storm Warriors with Outbreak, turn on Dark Transformation and kill them together with Epidemic, and put Putrefy into the Tempest Channeler.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] This pull chains straight from pull 10, so if Lightning Torrent targets you before Anti-Magic Shell is back, press Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec).
12: [우선 처치] When High Channeler Ryvati puts up Tempest Stormshield (a shield worth 20% of max health), stack Army of the Dead (if it is back), Dark Transformation and Putrefy to break it. If your team uses Bloodlust here on high keys, line them up with it.

[광역 피해] Absorb the 29095 Nature that pulses every second while the shield is up with Anti-Magic Shell. If the shield is about to expire unbroken and bring the 4 sec stun within 60 yd, press Icebound Fortitude, which makes you immune to stuns.

1: [위치] On the left route, pull the first Storm Adept with Death Grip (+10 yd range with Death's Reach) and bring it down to the bottom of the tunnel.
[우선 처치] Spread plagues with Outbreak, then line up Army of the Dead (1.5 min), Dark Transformation (45 sec) and Putrefy (30 sec) on the crowd-control-immune Sandfury Stonefist.

[광역 피해] When the Stonefist casts Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd and a knockback), turn on Death's Advance (45 sec) to ignore the knockback and stay in melee. Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Mind Freeze (15 sec) so it does not overlap, and press Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 8 sec) if your health is low.
2: [차단] Split the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) between Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
[우선 처치] Put Dark Transformation and Putrefy into the Sandfury Stonefist, and add Army of the Dead if it is back. Ignore Ground Pound's knockback with Death's Advance as on pull 1.
4: [우선 처치] Sand-Sworn Rider keeps calling Swarming Krolusks while it lives, so put Dark Transformation and Putrefy into the Rider to kill it fast.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Mind Freeze.
[참고] Unholy cannot dispel Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin poison, so absorb its 10 sec Nature DoT with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
5: [차단] A Lightning Bolt from the two Storm Adepts kills someone already hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin, so make sure to stop one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
[광역 피해] This is the biggest pull, so use Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation on the pack you gather first, and put Putrefy into the Sand-Sworn Rider that is pulled in late from the bridge.
[참고] If Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed (38793 Physical every 1 sec for 6 sec) hits you, heal back with Death Strike after the bleed ends.
6: [차단] One kicker is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, 5 sec disorient), so take it with Mind Freeze. If it lands it is a curse, and Unholy cannot dispel it. Pull Brood Tender in with Death Grip to stop its Venom Bolt.
[우선 처치] Put Dark Transformation and Putrefy into the Sand-Sworn Rider and kill it before Swarming Krolusks pile up.
7: [차단] Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt (116379 Nature) with Mind Freeze so it does not land on top of the Cytotoxin poison, and stop Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Death Grip if Mind Freeze is on cooldown.
[우선 처치] Line up Army of the Dead (if it is back), Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Sand-Sworn Rider.
9: [광역 피해] The two Agitated Nimbuses' Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to all players) goes off staggered. Absorb the first with Anti-Magic Shell, and if the healer is struggling, place Anti-Magic Zone (4 min, 15% magic damage reduction for 6 sec) for the next Release Charge.

[차단] Keep stopping the two Imbued Stormcallers' Lightning Bolt with Mind Freeze and Death Grip even while Release Charge goes off. While Anti-Magic Shell is up, the Imbued Conduction (Magic) DoT cannot be applied to you.
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers with Mind Freeze and Death Grip before gathering the other mobs.

[광역 피해] Line up Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy on the Agitated Nimbus to cut down its Release Charges, and absorb Release Charge with Anti-Magic Shell. Kill the four Static Anomalies together with Epidemic.
12: [회피] Do not rush the second Loose Sparks section before this pull (290947 Nature and a 6 sec stun); dodge it. If you cannot avoid a hit, press Icebound Fortitude to become immune to the stun.
[차단] Kick Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel with Mind Freeze, and pull the Disruptor on the other side with Death Grip to break its channel.

[광역 피해] Absorb Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT) with Anti-Magic Shell. Put Dark Transformation and Putrefy into the Orb Watcher, and hit the gathered Faithless Conscripts together with Epidemic.
13: [차단] Stop the two Temple Disruptors' Essence Disruption with Mind Freeze and Death Grip, as on pull 12.
[광역 피해] Absorb Caustic Stomp with Anti-Magic Shell, and use Army of the Dead on the Orb Watcher if it is back.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) is a must-kick. The Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so save Mind Freeze for Flame Shock.

[제어] Hold the four healer-chasing Faithless Tormentors with Blinding Sleet (1 min, 5 sec disorient then 50% slow) and Chains of Ice (70% movement speed reduction for 8 sec), and kill them fast with Epidemic while Dark Transformation is up.
